summary: I lead QA and test automation. Right now I'm most interested in how to test software when AI writes the tests.

At Etnetera Core I'm building QA Control Center. It's an agent-based system that maps a web application, proposes risks and acceptance criteria, and writes Playwright tests. I don't track how many tests pass. I track how many of them we can trust. A green test that checks nothing doesn't count as a pass. AI proposes, the tester decides, code measures.

I lead QA: test strategy, quality standards, mentoring testers, reporting quality and risk. I automate tests in Playwright and TypeScript, API and UI, wired into CI/CD. I run performance and load tests with k6. And I build and test AI-agent systems where a human makes the important calls.
Before QA I worked in sales and ran a small company. So I'm as comfortable talking to clients and business people as I am to engineers.

intro: I lead QA across projects at Etnetera Core and build tools that let AI take over routine testing work, while testers keep the decisions.
bullets: Building QA Control Center: 16 specialised AI agents turn requirements into risks, scenarios and Playwright tests. A tester approves the key steps, and the system shows how many tests can actually be trusted.
The system itself is covered by over 4,000 automated tests.
Responsible for testing strategy, quality standards and where test automation goes next.
Mentoring QA engineers and running load and performance tests in k6.

vision.title: How I work
vision.text: Tools matter, but in the end it's about people. A happy team with room to grow ships a better product than a team with perfect processes and bad morale. So I don't just set up processes. Mostly I make sure the team is a good place to work.

intro.title: When I close the laptop
intro.description: I work at a computer, but I clear my head outside. Mountains if I can, the sea if I can't. My best ideas still show up when I'm not thinking about work.

categories.name: Mountains
categories.description: I'm happiest in the mountains. Getting to the top and having a view that was worth it. Or putting on touring skis before dawn and going up while the slopes are empty and quiet.

categories.name: Water and running
categories.description: On a boat, the sun wakes me up and the first thing I do is jump in the sea. Running in the woods is my kind of meditation. I switch off and answers to work problems just show up.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Stuff I'm building around testing with AI. Plus a guesthouse in the mountains where I try AI with my own money.

items.name: QA Control Center
items.description: You give it a requirement and 16 specialised AI agents draft risks, acceptance criteria, test scenarios and ready-to-run Playwright tests. I built it because I'd seen plenty of generated tests that pass and check nothing. So the main number tells you how many tests can be trusted.
items.extra: There are human gates between the steps. Nothing moves on until QA says yes.

items.name: QA Brain
items.tagline: One set of QA rules for people and agents.
items.description: A set of QA rules where every rule has its own ID. Agents in Claude Code and Copilot read them and cite them, the way a colleague would in a code review.
items.extra: When an agent says which rule a test breaks, nobody has to ask why.

items.name: k6 performance framework
items.tagline: Even a PM can order a load test.
items.description: A framework on top of k6. A product manager who's never seen a script can order a load test with it. They answer five questions, or leave it all to the AI configurator.
items.extra: At the end they get a report they can read without a translator.

items.name: QA Manual Copilot
items.tagline: An AI sidekick for manual testers.
items.description: A Chrome extension that sits next to a manual tester. It suggests what else to try and helps write up a finding.
items.extra: It has one rule it can't skip: no claim without evidence. Every finding needs a screenshot, a log or an exact step.

items.name: MTP generator
items.tagline: A Master Test Plan that comes out the same every time.
items.description: A Master Test Plan generator. Code builds the structure, scope and rules from the input data, so the same data gives you the same plan.
items.extra: AI is only allowed to write the prose, like the intro and the summary.

items.name: Apartmány Iwona + AI
items.tagline: A mountain guesthouse as my lab.
items.description: We run a family guesthouse in the Krkonoše mountains. I collect pricing and occupancy data and see what AI can get out of it. Bit by bit I'm automating the routine around bookings and messages to guests.
